local_review.finding_body: The generated autoConfigurationCanBeCreated test only constructed target types and asserted that they were non-null, which did not exercise observable library behavior as required by FS-test-contract.1.3. The build also pinned org.springframework.ai:spring-ai-model to 2.0.0-RC2 instead of the TCK-resolved tested library version, making the suite version-specific contrary to FS-test-contract.2.5.
local_review.finding_title: Generated test used trivial assertions and pinned a companion artifact version
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the constructor-only non-null case with distinct default-value and configured-value behavior checks, changed spring-ai-model to use libraryVersion, and accepted the statistics refresh produced by finalization. The repaired tree passed the exact Forge-owned finalization command twice, with the final run making no publishable change.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff, test source and build configuration, metadata file shape, local gate evidence, and resolved statistics. The test package is separate, the scaffold is replaced, no Native Image skip or legacy metadata format is present, and the reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case for which the entry-count mismatch probe does not apply. After repair, the exact Forge finalization passed current-defaults, future-defaults-all, and GraalVM 25 test lanes, metadata and style checks, and stable statistics generation without further publishable changes.
